thing-xe-bang-fai-cave.label: TIME
thing-xe-bang-fai-cave.title: Day trip or overnight?
thing-xe-bang-fai-cave.body: The cave journey itself may take one to two hours, but the remote approach turns it into a full-day or multi-day plan. Keep margin for road conditions, the walk to the river and local coordination. Do not attach a fixed evening arrival elsewhere to the same day.

note.label: DAYLIGHT
note.text: Leave enough daylight for the remote road back.
